text:
mira_sales: Customer (regulated finance) requesting Private Deploy POC. Needs PrivateLink for isolation, AZ-HA, TGW/BGP as hot-standby, monthly EIP rotation, and the ability to correlate client IPs in our auth logs. Please provide a short netops handoff + security checklist they can paste into their ticket.

dan_netops: Short: PrivateLink interface endpoints NAT client IPs -> original src IP is not visible by default. Preserve client IP options: 1) in-VPC egress proxy that adds X-Forwarded-For or PROXY protocol to our edge; 2) route via TGW with customer NAT (BYOIP) so source is preserved (adds ops). If they insist on monthly EIP churn we need automation to update firewalls or a maintenance window.

leo_arch: HA pattern: create an interface endpoint per AZ + small HA proxy group autoscaled. For cross-region either replicate endpoints or use inter-region TGW. BGP failover: prefer VPCE route, BGP-learned TGW routes as lower priority. We'll provide a sample route preference doc if they want.

sasha_security: Security checklist (2 lines): provide KMS key policy and audit log retention; confirm TLS mode (mTLS preferred) and agree on an EIP rotation schedule with a maintenance window and automated firewall updates.

dan_netops: Minimal firewall snippet for ops (replace placeholders):
```
# egress from customer VPC -> Redwood POC
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to 54.34.210.77/32 port 443
# if using interface endpoints, allow to vpce IDs or ENI IPs
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to vpce-0123456789abcdef port 443
```
Note: if they terminate TLS for inspection, prefer mTLS or PROXY protocol to preserve identity and avoid SNI rewrite problems.

mira_sales: 3-line handoff for the customer's netops:
- Deploy PrivateLink interface endpoints in each AZ and front with HA proxies for low-latency; enable privatelink DNS.
- PrivateLink NATs client IP; to preserve source IP run an in-VPC egress proxy that sets X-Forwarded-For or use PROXY protocol, or route via TGW with customer NAT/BYOIP.
- Open outbound TCP/443 to assigned EIP(s) or VPCE IDs; rotating EIPs monthly requires automation + a maintenance window. Expect per-endpoint hourly + per-GB processing charges.

leo_arch: Blockers before POC: their network diagram, expected monthly egress (GB), peak RPS, and whether they will inspect TLS.

mira_sales: Thanks all 680 I'll add their diagram and traffic estimate to the POC ticket today.
